articles.title: First trailer for Lionel Messi's animated show 'Messi and the Giants' features music from Luck Ra
articles.summary: The animated Disney series Messi and the Giants, executive produced by soccer star Lionel Messi, revealed its first teaser at San Diego Comic-Con Málaga. It will premiere on Disney+ in summer 2027.

articles.title: This walking robot hand looks like a futuristic Thing from 'The Addams Family'
articles.summary: Engineers at ETH Zurich built a robot hand that balances on its uneven fingers, walks over carpet, gravel and grass, and can type and play a puzzle game. The work is described in a preprint that has not yet been peer-reviewed.

articles.title: New 'plant armor' more than triples strawberry yields
articles.summary: A textile cover called Plant Armor helped strawberry plants produce more than three times as much fruit in tunnel field trials with no harmful effects on plant health. Researchers say it may also cut pesticide and water use.
